title: Home-court advantage pinned to the measured home-win rate (R09)
rule: HCA is NOT fitted. It is the points equivalent of the measured home-win rate: sigma_margin * Phi^-1(home_win_rate), computed on finals whose quarter scores sum to the printed final.
note_staleness: The site's published pin (0.5204 / 0.87 pts, session arena/23ec1e32-nba1, COORDINATION §61) was measured on the standings capture through 2026-11-16 18:35Z and on finals through 2026-11-15. This row is measured on the per-game feed through 2026-11-16 - the day's eight verified finals are included. The difference between the two is the sample, not a correction: 0.5171 over 205 decided feed games vs 0.5204 over the 196 home/road games the standings page printed. Both are published; neither is blended.
